name: Doktas Dokumculuk Ticaret ve Sanayi A.S.
summary: Döktas Dökümcülük Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi manufactures and sells pig, ductile, and aluminum castings for automotive, heavy commercial vehicles, construction, and agricultural machinery industries in Turkey. The company also produces aluminum wheels. It also exports its products. Döktas Dökümcülük Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi was formerly known as Componenta Dökümcülük Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi and changed its name to Döktas Dökümcülük Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi in April 2018. The company was founded in 1973 and is based in Bursa, Turkey. Döktas Dökümcülük Ticaret ve Sanayi Anonim Sirketi is a subsidiary of Çelik Holding A.S.
